operations.idempotency: Exact Session/incarnation + requestId + entire validated request including ordered proposal. Re-authorize and recheck current captured context before reuse and after awaits; conflicting request fails REPLAY_MISMATCH. Plan receipts confer no apply/recovery authority.

semantics.source: Only BuildProposal is model-controlled. Trusted Workshop captures BuildProposalContext before generation and attaches the returned proposal to that immutable context; it obtains current facts from public providers and actual confirmed durable turn/brief. Model-stated Session/grant/transaction/confirmation/evidence are forbidden. Full request/identity/context is assembled by trusted business code, not accepted verbatim from a model tool call.
semantics.authority: Host/Painter authenticate the exact caller service and delegate only ValidateBuildProposal for this invocation; follow existing planning INSPECT scope, not APPLY_RECOVERABLE. Verify actual live Session incarnation and original grant/epoch/world/actor/actions through Host/Adapter. BuildProposalProviderFacts are provider-owned observations, never JSON proof. Unknown/revoked/expired/regranted original grant, replacement Session or ended/cancelled invocation refuses output and replay. Recheck current confirmed context after asynchronous work and immediately before release; do not cache a previous successful permission check.
semantics.binding: Source and current context must equal every admitted context field, including actor/Session/authorization/world/turn/invocation, same ReferenceBrief revision/content/empty media, confirmed Intent, region inspection/frame/evidence, catalogue and SafetyProfile. A changed brief/control/world/selection/placement/catalogue/policy invalidates the proposal; never silently rebind stale model geometry. Existing public digests bind the carried projections; no new private digest is needed. Replay compares the full request including proposal and requestId.
semantics.geometry: Reuse picture-blocks materials and ordered local boxes. Local origin is targetFacts.sampledBounds.min, inclusive integer boxes translate exactly; safe-integer overflow, negative/reversed/out-of-bounds boxes, absent material, occupied/unknown/unsampled cells and body/protection overlap reject. No clipping, resizing, inferred empty cells or arbitrary global size cap. Safety flags remain required; static material and hazard checks remain. Painter must recompute entrance/cavity/avatar connectivity and entranceFacing using its existing domain rules before assembly, even if generic contract checks pass.
semantics.result: Reuse BuildPlan and build digest. Result must preserve exact materials, translated ordered boxes, bound frame/catalogue/target/safety, invocation and request identity. Witnesses must use actual relayed inspection evidence; public helpers check payload coherence and required witnesses only, not provider authenticity or full architectural suitability. Failed validation returns existing typed error with NONE/null transaction, never a world receipt. Skill handles clarification from errors; Painter invokes no model.
semantics.boundary: New producer capability check applies only to the ValidateBuildProposal Painter service and exact current package. Default a467/0.3.9 builds remain on their fixed source/package independently; do not relabel advertisements, replace in-flight artifacts or broadcast a global pin update. This branch is for the approved skill consumers when their own cards adopt it; no old-peer/profile compatibility or migration. No Canvas/Adapter/Brush/Undo wire change, no new write permission, no second model loop.
